items.title: He was right about AI and still lost $35 billion
items.summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner turned $225 million into a $45 billion fund in under two years by betting on everything AI would need. Then 4x leverage and a brutal July cost him $35 billion from the peak. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down the essay, the bets, the margin calls and Citadel's block trade, and whether he can run it back.

items.title: Amazon Blocked Meta’s Muse Two Months Ago. Now It’s in Talks to Let It Shop, and Walmart Already Did
items.summary: Key TakeawaysFortune reported that Amazon and Meta are in talks to let Meta’s Muse agent shop on Amazon, two months after Amazon blocked it. Walmart already lets Muse shop its Black Friday deals, and Shopify signed on as a Muse partner early, so Amazon is the big holdout.
